# ACT Mindfully

> A comprehensive resource for Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) and mindfulness training led by world-renowned psychologist Dr Russ Harris.

ACT Mindfully offers evidence-based psychological training through workshops, online courses, and published materials. The site serves mental health professionals, individuals seeking therapy, and those interested in mindfulness-based personal development, with a focus on values-based living and acceptance strategies.

## Key Topics

- Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT)
- Mindfulness
- Dr Russ Harris
- The Happiness Trap
- Values-based living
- Mental health training
- ACT workshops
- Online ACT courses
- Clinical training
- Trauma-Focused ACT
- Interactive learning
- Mental health professionals
- ACT Made Simple
- Mindfulness practices
- Psychological wellbeing

## About ACT Mindfully

- [Acceptance and Commitment Therapy | ACT Mindfully](https://www.actmindfully.com.au): Homepage introducing Dr Russ Harris and ACT therapy with bestselling book The Happiness Trap
- [Who is Dr Russ Harris? Find out here | ACT Mindfully](https://www.actmindfully.com.au/about-russ): Biography of Dr Russ Harris, world-renowned ACT trainer and author
- [What is ACT and Mindfulness? Find Out Here | ACT Mindfully](https://www.actmindfully.com.au/about-act): Explanation of Acceptance and Commitment Therapy and mindfulness psychology
- [What is Mindfulness? What are the benefits? | ACT Mindfully](https://www.actmindfully.com.au/about-mindfulness): Guide to mindfulness benefits, stress reduction, and conscious living practices

## Workshops & Training

- [ACT Workshops from Basic to Advanced | ACT Mindfully](https://www.actmindfully.com.au/workshops): Overview of ACT workshops with dates, locations, and pricing information
- [ACT Workshops - In Person & Online - from Basic to Advanced | ACT Mindfully](https://www.actmindfully.com.au/workshops/in-person-workshops-with-dr-russ-harris): Detailed workshop listings from beginner to advanced levels with Dr Russ Harris
- [Online Training in ACT - Interactive Courses | Actmindfully](https://www.actmindfully.com.au/act-online-training): Interactive online ACT courses including ACT for Beginners and ACT for ADHD
- [Online Training in ACT - Interactive Courses | Actmindfully](https://www.actmindfully.com.au/online): Online ACT training courses with interactive learning and therapy demonstrations
- [Workshop Information - Venue, Travel & Prep | Actmindfully](https://www.actmindfully.com.au/workshops/in-person-workshops-with-dr-russ-harris/workshop-venues-information): Workshop venue details, travel logistics, parking, and catering information

## Books & Resources

- [ACT Books Written by Dr Russ Harris | ACT Mindfully](https://www.actmindfully.com.au/product-category/books): Catalog of Dr Russ Harris ACT books including The Happiness Trap and related titles
- [Happiness Trap Cards | Actmindfully](https://www.actmindfully.com.au/happiness-trap-cards): ACT-based card deck product for mindfulness practices and mental wellness
